Alert: You gain +5 to initiative. You cannot be surprised and creatures do not gain advantage on attack rolls from being hidden from you.
Athlete: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1. Climbing no longer costs extra movement. You can stand up using only 5 feet of movement. You can make a running jump after moving only 5 feet.
Actor: Increase your Charisma by 1. You have advantage on Deception and Performance checks to pass as someone else. You can mimic the speech of another creature or sounds you have heard.
Charger: When you take the Dash action, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack or shove a creature. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line before the attack, you gain a +5 bonus to the damage roll.
Crossbow Expert: You ignore the loading property of crossbows. Attacks with ranged weapons within 5 feet do not cause disadvantage. When you attack with a hand crossbow, you can make an additional attack with it as a bonus action.
Defensive Duelist: When wielding a finesse weapon you are proficient with, you can add your proficiency bonus to your AC as a reaction against one melee attack.
Dual Wielder: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wielding two melee weapons. You can use two-weapon fighting even if the weapons are not light. You can draw or stow two weapons when you normally would draw or stow one.
Dungeon Delver: You have advantage on Perception and Investigation checks made to detect secret doors. You have advantage on saving throws to resist traps. You have resistance to damage dealt by traps. Traveling at a fast pace doesn't impose the normal -5 penalty on your passive Wisdom (Perception) score.
Durable: Increase your Constitution by 1. When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points you regain equals twice your Constitution modifier.
Great Weapon Master: Before a melee attack with a heavy weapon, you can take a -5 penalty to gain +10 to the damage roll. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points or score a critical hit, you can make a bonus melee weapon attack.
Healer: You can use a healer's kit to stabilize a dying creature. As an action, you can also restore 1d6 + 4 + the creature's number of Hit Dice worth of hit points. Usable once per short or long rest per creature.
Heavy Armor Master: Increase your Strength by 1. While wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 3.
Inspiring Leader: Spend 10 minutes to inspire up to 6 creatures within 30 feet who can see or hear you. Each gains temporary hit points equal to your level + Charisma modifier. Usable after a short or long rest.
Keen Mind: Increase your Intelligence by 1. You always know which way is north. You always know the number of hours until sunrise or sunset. You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.
Lightly Armored: You gain proficiency with light armor.
Linguist: Increase your Intelligence by 1. You learn three languages of your choice. You can ably create written ciphers that others cannot decipher without your help.
Lucky: You have 3 luck points. When you make an attack, ability check, or save, you can spend 1 luck point to roll an additional d20 and choose which to use. You can also spend 1 luck point when an enemy rolls against you. You regain all luck points after a long rest.
Mage Slayer: When a creature within 5 feet casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it. When you damage a creature concentrating on a spell, it has disadvantage on its concentration save. You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.
Magic Initiate: Choose a class: learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from that class's spell list. You can cast the 1st-level spell once per long rest at its lowest level.
Martial Adept: You learn two maneuvers of your choice from the Battle Master archetype. You gain one superiority die (d6) that recharges after a short or long rest. If a maneuver requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier.
Medium Armor Master: Increase your Strength by 1. Wearing medium armor does not impose disadvantage on Stealth checks. When wearing medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC from Dexterity.
Mobile: Your speed increases by 10 feet. When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain does not cost extra movement. When you make a melee attack against a creature, it cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.
Mounted Combatant: You have advantage on melee attack rolls against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount. You can force attacks targeting your mount to target you instead. Your mount takes no damage from Dexterity saves on a success and half on a failure.
Observant: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1. You can read lips. Your passive Perception and passive Investigation scores increase by 5.
Polearm Master: When you take the Attack action with a polearm, you can make a bonus attack with the opposite end dealing 1d4 bludgeoning. Enemies provoke opportunity attacks from you when they enter your reach.
Resilient: Choose one ability score. You gain a +1 to that score and proficiency in saving throws using that ability.
Ritual Caster: You gain a ritual book holding two 1st-level ritual spells from any class of your choice. You can cast spells with the ritual tag from your book as rituals. You can add more ritual spells to the book from scrolls or spellbooks.
Sentinel: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, its speed becomes 0. Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they take the Disengage action. When a creature within 5 feet attacks an ally, you can make a melee attack against it as a reaction.
Sharpshooter: Attacking at long range does not impose disadvantage. Ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. Before an attack, you can take a -5 penalty to gain +10 damage.
Shield Master: If you take the Attack action, you can shove a creature within 5 feet as a bonus action. You can add your shield's AC bonus to Dexterity saving throws against spells or effects that target only you. When subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity save for half damage, you can use your reaction to take no damage on a success.
Skilled: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.
Skulker: You can try to hide when you are lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding. If you miss with a ranged weapon attack while hidden, your position is not revealed. Dim light does not impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.
Spell Sniper: When you cast a spell that requires an attack roll, the range is doubled. Ranged spell attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. You learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll from any class.
Tavern Brawler: Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1. You are proficient with improvised weapons. Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage. When you hit with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon, you can grapple as a bonus action.
Tough: Your hit point maximum increases by 2 for each level you have gained.
War Caster: You have advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration. You can perform somatic components of spells even when holding weapons or a shield. When a creature provokes an opportunity attack, you can cast a cantrip targeting it instead of making a melee attack.
Weapon Master: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1. You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.
